title: Best Game Trailer Editors (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a game trailer editor for Steam, consoles or mobile stores: what to include, capturing footage, formats, price factors and red flags.
intro: A game trailer shows what your game is, how it plays and why it is worth wishlisting or installing. It appears on store pages, social media and at events. Trailers go wrong when they show too little gameplay, open slowly, use footage that does not reflect the real game, or break store rules. This guide helps you plan a trailer that sells your game honestly.

faq.q: What makes a good game trailer?
faq.a: Clear gameplay early, a strong opening, a sense of what makes the game unique, and a clear call to action such as wishlist now.
Usually you or the developer provide high-quality captures. Some editors can capture footage if given a build.
Yes. Many stores require trailers to show real gameplay and limit certain content. Check the store's rules.
Horizontal for store pages and YouTube, vertical for short-form social media, and sometimes square.

faq.q: Can I use music from other games or artists?
faq.a: Only with a license. Use original music or licensed tracks.
